What We Do

Our Services, Finished Properly

From a single room to a whole property, every project begins with thorough preparation — because a beautiful finish is built long before the final coat.

Interior Painting

Walls, ceilings and feature colours for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and halls — prepared, primed and finished to a flawless standard.

Exterior Painting

Masonry, render, doors and windows refreshed and protected with durable, weather-resistant exterior coatings.

Wallpaper Hanging

Precise hanging of feature-wall and whole-room wallpapers, with pattern matching and seams that all but disappear.

Residential Decorating

Complete home decorating for houses and flats of every size — one trusted team from first visit to final walkthrough.

Commercial Painting

Offices, shops, cafés and rental properties decorated efficiently, with flexible scheduling to minimise disruption.

Woodwork & Finishing

Skirting, architraves, doors, staircases and fitted furniture — sanded, filled and finished in satin, eggshell or gloss.

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

How do quotations work — are they really free?+
Yes. Quotations are free and carry no obligation. We visit your property, discuss the work, measure up and provide a detailed written quotation so you can decide in your own time.
What preparation do you do before painting?+
Preparation is where a lasting finish is made: surfaces are cleaned, cracks and holes filled, sanded smooth, and primed where needed. Woodwork is sanded and undercoated before its top coats.
Will my furniture and floors be protected?+
Absolutely. Furniture is moved or fully covered, floors are sheeted, and edges are masked. We tidy as we go and leave every room clean at the end of each day.
How long will my project take?+
A single room typically takes a few days including preparation and drying time. Larger or whole-house projects are scheduled in stages, and your quotation will include a realistic timescale before we start.
Can you help me choose paint colours and finishes?+
Of course. We're happy to talk through colour ideas, sheen levels and durable finishes for busy areas, and can suggest tester pots so you can live with a colour before committing.
Which areas do you cover?+
We cover our local towns and surrounding villages — the confirmed list of areas and postcodes will be published here shortly. Send us your postcode with your enquiry and we'll confirm coverage right away.
